Contract/artifact digests establish byte identity relative to the pinned owner artifact, not authenticity or truth by themselves.
JSON Schema does not replace lexical integer rules, checked selector ordering/preimages, live authorization or retained provenance.
Application dispatch and native IO are exercised; only explicitly mapped protocol bodies receive the stated Verus coverage.
Control faults are rejected/no-effect outcomes. Future Splicery or other effects require distinct Unknown/partial outcome projection, retained reservations and reconciliation.
